evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from ~28800 to 13.9 ppm, and it stayed at 4-7 ppm afterward
Thermocouple stayed within ~1 °C of the setpoint through the whole ramp
Brief overshoot to 760.6 °C when growth started, then settled at 750.0 °C
Heater power steady at ~45% during the hold, which fits the temperature
Ar ~100 sccm matches the setpoint; pressure steady at ~760 Torr

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet (e.g., Raman/optical) to show whether growth happened, and no reference statistics were provided to compare against.
